items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: they had Benny Goodman, had all the stars, Billy Eckstine, Lena Horne, Georgia Auld, Duke Ellington, Louis Armstrong. I mean the works.

ctx.x: So I started taking me some money, Helen. So I was making off of T-Bone. He'd lay down with me some good money — I'd hang out in the evening and put that guitar and make that lickety-split, "In the evening, baby when the sun goes down, doo doo doo, and they'd scream "Wow" and throw that money down there ... from the balcony and everywhere.

And he'd go up and gamble it and tell Louie, and I'd say, "I'm not gambling nothing, I'm gonna take some of this money." And I'd give him his money and he'd still give me ten, but he never knew what I had. I'm being honest with you. Because I didn't feel bad. If he's gonna lose it to somebody, he might as well lose some to me.
Am I saying the wrong thing?
